title: Replace one-shot reviewer password-reset SMTP delivery with encrypted durable auth-mail outbox and transient retry worker
acceptance: the password-reset challenge and encrypted PASSWORD_RESET mail intent are created in the same PostgreSQL transaction
the reset bearer token and recipient are never returned from the auth API to the Web password-reset route
the Web password-reset route no longer sends SMTP or Resend directly
legacy Web transactional-mail authority is preserved for current non-migrated shared callers; this preservation is compatibility only and is not a Gekta implementation task
auth.mail_outbox uses FORCE RLS, least-privilege enqueue/runtime/retention authorities, encrypted payloads, idempotency and terminal ciphertext redaction
SMTP 4xx and transport failures are retried with bounded exponential backoff and jitter; SMTP 5xx and invalid recipient/message failures are dead-lettered immediately
the observed production SMTP_TRANSIENT_451 path is covered by a regression test
the auth-mail worker uses the exact API image revision and a distinct pc_auth_mail_runtime PostgreSQL principal
the worker receives its SMTP and database credentials only through root-authority read-only file mounts; API and Web do not receive worker-specific AUTH_MAIL credentials
current shared API/Web runtime authority files and the existing Web transactional-mail environment file are preserved during cutover and rollback
production cutover runs only after successful Production Full-Stack Exact-SHA Release for current main and skips without mutation on main drift
any cutover failure restores the pre-release API/Web baseline and the prior auth-mail worker state when present
production evidence proves exact API/Web/worker SHA, worker readiness, auth-mail runtime PASS, preserved legacy Web transactional-mail authority, and absence of SMTP authority from API
no reset request is replayed by the deployment workflow itself and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB
